mission: LÉLU 22.5 — historical residue eliminated in the real application
surface: the real GenesisV1/GenesisInterface, Chat Universe, Memory module; ?scene=off is the development-only presentation switch used since M22.3
provider: same-origin /api/model broker — OpenRouter nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free answered 200 for all four post-restart requests
why_the_legacy_record_was_seeded: The M22.4 browser profile lived on an older preview origin; a new runner assigned a new origin, so the pre-fix COPPER checkpoint from M22.4 was not present here. To exercise the migration against a copy the old writer would have produced, one was written into lelu.projects.v1 with the old writer's exact shape (description “Auto-created for general tasks”, summary = the turn's request, completed = the reply, no pending work, no next action) after the memory had been deleted. Everything after that point — the dry run, the migration, the storage inspection, the reload, the app restart and the provider payloads — is the unmodified application.
